description: Biotechnology is governed for health equity ecological responsibility and shared benefits.
Biomanufacturing and synthetic biology scale rapidly while governance lags.
Advanced therapies and genetic services concentrate among wealthy populations.
A major accident misuse event or governance failure triggers distrust and restriction.
Biotechnology becomes central to remediation climate adaptation and biodiversity monitoring.
Patents platforms datasets therapies seeds and biofoundries concentrate among powerful actors.
Public deliberation affected-community voice and shared governance shape biological innovation.
